properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 3 at 9:17AM CDT until August 6 at 1:00PM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Major flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Major flooding is occurring and major flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Nueces River near Three Rivers.

* WHEN...Until Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 37.3 feet, Widespread lowland flooding occurs. Minor
roads are closed. Airport Road boat ramp near Live Oak County
Airport is flooded and closed. Major flooding occurs in the River
Creek Acres Subdivision, with several feet of water and several
homes flooded. Residents in the J.I. Hailey Subdivision at Jones
River bend have trouble getting out as water covers much of
Antelope Lane.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:15 AM CDT Monday the stage was 37.4 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 20.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall into moderate flood
stage Tuesday, then fall below flood stage midday Thursday. The
river will then continue to fall to 12.8 feet Saturday morning.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 3 at 5:38PM EDT until August 3 at 8:45PM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
properties.description:
FFWAKQ

The National Weather Service in Wakefield has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northeastern Cumberland County in central Virginia...
West Central Goochland County in central Virginia...
Northwestern Powhatan County in central Virginia...

* Until 845 PM EDT.

* At 538 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Cartersville, Lakeside Village, Duncan, Whiteville, Tamworth,
Pemberton, Ashby and Trenton Mills.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Please report flooding by calling 757-899-2415, posting to the NWS
Wakefield Facebook page, or using X @NWSWAKEFIELDVA.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 3 at 2:40PM MST until August 3 at 5:45PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
FFWTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
East Central Santa Cruz County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 545 PM MST.

* At 240 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain in the Canelo area. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible
in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Elgin and Canelo.

This includes Route 83 between mile markers 10 and 23.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Santa Cruz River, Turkey Creek and Babocomari River.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

In hilly terrain there are hundreds of low water crossings which are
potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not attempt to cross flooded
roads. Find an alternate route.
